title: Niranjan Singh v. State of M.P.

content.caseIdentity: Niranjan Singh v. State of M.P., (2007) 11 SCC 109
content.holding: Distinguished "hurt which endangers life" under Clause (h) from injuries likely to cause death under culpable homicide; Section 116(h) applies where the injury puts life in jeopardy but homicidal intention is absent.
